scope: Actual current implementation and remaining initial blob snapshot; measured effects are separate.

findings.behavior: Bounded 4096-entry TLS cache, at most 16 probes. Hits compare immutable registered names and return IDs without global lock or key-string allocation. Misses retain original registry semantics.
Draw and RHI handle copies retain immutable blob metadata instead of copying three strings. Blob() returns a borrowed const reference under the owning handle.
Initial handle construction still snapshots the descriptor blob; subsequent copies share it. No descriptor/frame-arena pointer is retained.
Collection output storage persists on the render thread and is reused; existing pending/fence gates still control collection and submission.
GPU scope suffix uses a stack buffer; marker spelling and ordinal are preserved.
Retains timing strings and copies only changed names; slice names use the same content check.
